components.name: Primary Circulation Button
components.description: Primary emerald CTA for recording attendance, loans, returns, and saves.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; height: 38px; padding: 0 15px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: #15803d; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Onest', sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #166534; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #15803d; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Live Stock Ratio Meter
components.description: Signature availability progress meter displaying Tersedia / Total copies per title.
components.html: 8 / 10Tersedia
components.css: .ds-stock-meter { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; min-width: 140px; font-family: 'Onest', sans-serif; } .ds-stock-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 12.5px; } .ds-frac { font-weight: 600; color: #14221c; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-state { font-size: 11.5px; color: #66776f; } .ds-track { width: 100%; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: #e6eae5; overflow: hidden; } .ds-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 999px; background: #15803d; }

components.name: Overdue Circulation Badge
components.description: Warm amber warning pill flagging overdue or due-today loans.
components.css: .ds-pill-amber { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 999px; background: #fef3c7; border: 1px solid #fde68a; color: #b45309; font-family: 'Onest', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Circulation Work Sheet
components.description: Crisp white container framed in 1px linen hairline on daylight paper ground.
components.html:
Katalog Koleksi Buku
Daftar inventaris buku dengan status peminjaman real-time.
components.css: .ds-sheet { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e2e6e1; border-radius: 14px; font-family: 'Onest', sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20, 34, 28, 0.04), 0 4px 14px rgba(20, 34, 28, 0.03); } .ds-sheet-head { padding: 16px 22px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e6e1; font-weight: 600; color: #14221c; } .ds-sheet-body { padding: 20px 22px; color: #43544b; font-size: 13.5px; }

components.name: Kiosk NIS Input
components.description: Large monospaced autocomplete field for student check-in at the library desk.
components.html: <input class="ds-kiosk-input" type="text" placeholder="Ketik NIS anggota..." value="20240101" />
components.css: .ds-kiosk-input { width: 100%; height: 48px; padding: 10px 14px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 15px; color: #14221c; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #c9d1c7; border-radius: 6px; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-kiosk-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #15803d; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(21, 128, 61, 0.14); }

narrative.overview: Library Circulation Desk pairs a quiet, inviting entrance kiosk (/) with an inventory-first librarian console (/admin/*). A deep botanical forest-emerald rail grounds operational tools on the left while daylight reading-room paper (#f7f8f6) keeps dense catalogs, member rosters, and active loans airy and scannable.
keyCharacteristics: Dual-surface architecture: calm standalone NIS check-in card on / and 248px botanical-emerald console shell on /admin/*.
Live Stock Ratio Meter per book showing remaining copies (Tersedia / Total) with automatic threshold tinting (<= 2 amber, 0 crimson).
Persistent overdue row highlighting (#fffbeb) and single-click return confirmation via inline SweetAlert prompts.
Monospace tabular discipline (JetBrains Mono) for book codes, member NIS numbers, and due dates.

rules.name: The Overdue Spotlight Rule
rules.body: Unreturned loans past tanggalwajibkembali carry a persistent subtle warm-amber row background (#fffbeb) and pill badge (Telat X hari) so late items never blend into normal circulation history.

rules.name: The Linen-Edge Rule
rules.body: Admin tables, forms, and KPI tiles are separated by 1px solid #e2e6e1 edges on white sheets rather than heavy drop shadows or colored left border strips.

dos: Do highlight overdue active loans persistently with .is-overdue amber row tint and Telat X hari badges.
Do show the Live Stock Ratio Meter for catalog availability instead of plain integer counts alone.
donts: Don't include real-world school names or legacy template strings; keep neutral SIPerpustakaan identity.
Don't route delete actions to standalone GET confirmation pages; confirm destructives inline via .js-confirm-action + DELETE POST forms.
